name: Fyndhorn
description: Neighboring elven land to the south with which Kjeldor established trade relations.

description_citations.text: "Kjeldor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kolbjörn says Freyalise cleansed the druids' bodies and gave them Fyndhorn.
timeline.quote: "Freyalise has cleansed our bodies and minds of the plagues of Kjeldor;

citation.text: Essence Filter (Ice Age, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kaysa goes with Kolbjörn to Fyndhorn with Halvor's consent, and Disa travels with them.
timeline.quote: Disa would travel with Kolbjörn and Kaysa to Fyndhorn.

citation.text: "Disa", section "Feast of Kjeld". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Disa defeats and tames a lhurgoyf that ambushed her party, learning to tame others as guides.
timeline.quote: Disa faced it head-on and, after a grueling fight, managed to defeat and subdue it

citation.text: "Disa", section "Encountering lhurgoyfs". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kjeldor trades with Fyndhorn, and elves teach its healers in exchange for keeping orcs at bay.
timeline.quote: The elves taught Kjeldor's healers in exchange for keeping the neighboring orcs at bay.

citation.text: "Kjeldor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taaveti says the Fyndhorn orphans find no welcome in Yavimaya.
timeline.quote: "We orphans of Fyndhorn have found no welcome in this alien place."

citation.text: Yavimaya Ancients (Alliances, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Freyalise cleanses the Juniper Order of the plagues of Kjeldor and grants a home in Fyndhorn.
timeline.quote: Freyalise has cleansed our bodies and minds of the plagues of Kjeldor

citation.text: Essence Filter (Masters Edition II, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
